title: Just Juice Bar Below Zero Blue Cherry Blast 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blue Cherry Blast from the Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range is a punchy fruit blend that contrasts juicy sweetness with a cooling finish. Bold Blueberry delivers a deep, jammy base, while ripe Cherry layers in its bright, red-fruit richness. The flavour is sharpened by a blast of Ice, creating a vibrant and refreshing vape that’s bursting with character. Blended with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides rapid satisfaction with a smooth throat feel, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) devices such as pod kits and vape pens. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, it offers options for both light and heavier nicotine preferences. Made in the UK at a 60PG/40VG ratio, Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range Nic Salts are designed for flavour clarity and subtle vapour, bringing disposable-inspired profiles into a convenient 10ml refill format. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
